finalText:
It started at 02:14:07 with redis going unreachable at 10.0.0.12:6379. That knocked out the cache, so every request fell back to the store directly.

From there it snowballed. Cache misses piled up, requests started timing out at 5 seconds, and the request queue grew nonstop, from 52 up past 500 by 02:29. Redis reconnect attempts kept failing every couple minutes, 12 tries total, redis never came back.

By 02:31:44 worker-2 ran out of memory from the backlog and crashed. Eight seconds later the api process stopped responding entirely, and the supervisor killed the whole service at 02:31:52.

**Root cause:** redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 went down and never reconnected, and nothing shed load once the queue backed up, so it starved out into a full outage. Fixing this needs either a working redis failover or a queue cap that sheds load instead of piling up.
